forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO. The 37th Knesset completed its full four-year term and dissolved naturally on July 17, 2026 — the first Knesset to complete a full term since 1988 (Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, 2026-07-17). The coalition held a one-seat majority (61/120) through the dissolution date; no roll-call vote confirmed a drop below 61. Resolution criteria 'NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact' is fully met. Both YES pathways are closed.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas.

forecasts.question: Will Iran publicly commit to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations (a named Iranian official or MFA announces readiness for talks) before EOD 2026-09-06?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO. No named Iranian official issued a public statement committing to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations before EOD September 6. FM Araghchi's last public statement on negotiations (Al Jazeera, August 15) confirmed 'no decision yet.' Active US-Iran kinetic exchange on September 1-2 — CENTCOM airstrikes on IRGC targets inside Iran, followed by Iranian ballistic missile and drone retaliation including Kuwait airspace intercepts — produced zero diplomatic signals. The September 6 horizon passed with both sides in active military posture.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-09-06, a named Iranian official (FM Araghchi, Supreme National Security Council, or IRNA/Tasnim/Press TV quoting an official) issues a public statement committing to resuming or entering mediated ceasefire negotiations with the United States. A 'readiness for talks' declaration counts; mere written-message relay does NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: One TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera) citing the named Iranian official, OR Iranian state media (IRNA/Tasnim) carrying the official statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Conditional or preconditioned offers ('will talk if US stops strikes') = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO unless the US publicly accepts the condition; a mediator asserting Iran is 'open' without a named Iranian official statement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will a new Iran-US ceasefire (or bilateral halt in offensive operations) be publicly confirmed by BOTH the US government AND the Iranian government before EOD 2026-10-01?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 14-day forecast. The first ceasefire (April 8 - July 8, 2026, Pakistan-mediated) lasted 90 days before the June MOU collapsed. Active kinetic exchange resumed July 8. Despite the 'intermittent' war characterization (NPR, September 2), both sides are in offensive military posture as of September 1-3 with no active mediator sessions scheduled. Pakistan has maintained message-relay capacity but has not announced a new convened session. The structural barriers — US naval blockade (April 13), Iran's Lebanon-ceasefire precondition, active ballistic missile exchange — remain unresolved. A rapid ceasefire breakthrough analogous to April 8 is possible (it took 38 days from war start to that ceasefire) but requires a political decision not currently signaled by either side.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-10-01, both the US White House/DoD AND the Iranian MFA/SNSC/IRNA issue public confirmations of a ceasefire or bilateral halt in offensive military operations — both sides must confirm; one-sided declarations do not count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: US: White House statement OR DoD official release. Iran: IRNA/Tasnim official statement OR named MFA spokesperson. Each confirmed by at least one TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Unilateral US ceasefire declaration without Iranian government confirmation = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Iranian 'readiness' statement without US confirmation = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. A mediator-only readout without bilateral government statements = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei or the Supreme National Security Council publicly articulate a specific new negotiating framework (naming at minimum a condition that differs from stated preconditions, or a named interlocutor level and venue) before EOD 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 40-day forecast. After the June 2026 MOU collapsed and fighting resumed July 8, Iran has not articulated a new public negotiating framework. Khamenei's public positions since July 8 have maintained existing preconditions (halt US strikes, Israel-Lebanon ceasefire, JCPOA-plus terms). Internal economic pressure from the US naval blockade, continued Hormuz disruption, and war attrition may produce a regime signal shift within 40 days. Historical precedent: Khamenei's June 2026 MOU endorsement was considered a significant departure from prior posture and emerged under similar pressure. P=0.22 reflects the possibility but acknowledges Khamenei's track record of prolonged public rigidity before pivots.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-10-27, Khamenei personally (KHAMENEI.IR), the SNSC Secretary (MFA spokesperson), or FM Araghchi issues a public statement containing a specific new offer: a named negotiating venue or format not previously proposed, OR a named condition that goes beyond the stated preconditions of halting US strikes and the Lebanon ceasefire prerequisite.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: IRNA/Tasnim/Press TV (Iranian state media) carrying the statement, confirmed by at least one TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP) with direct quotation.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: A restatement of existing preconditions — 'halt US strikes' or 'Israel must stop Lebanon campaign' — is NO even if phrased as an 'offer.' A vague 'Iran is open to talks' from an unnamed official = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. The offer must be SPECIFIC and NEW per the resolution criteria.
